title: Our Heavenly Dwelling, The Ministry of Reconciliation

questions.question: For we know that if the tent that is our earthly home is destroyed, we have a ____ from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:1 (ESV): "For we know that if the tent that is our earthly home is destroyed, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens."

questions.question: For in this tent we groan, longing to put on our ____,
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:2 (ESV): "For in this tent we groan, longing to put on our heavenly dwelling,"

questions.question: He who has prepared us for this very thing is God, who has given us the ____ as a guarantee.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:5 (ESV): "He who has prepared us for this very thing is God, who has given us the Spirit as a guarantee."

questions.question: So we are always of good courage. We know that while we are at home in the body we are ____ the Lord,
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:6 (ESV): "So we are always of good courage. We know that while we are at home in the body we are away from the Lord,"

questions.question: for we walk by ____, not by sight.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:7 (ESV): "for we walk by faith, not by sight."

questions.question: Yes, we are of good courage, and we would rather be away from the body and at ____ with the Lord.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:8 (ESV): "Yes, we are of good courage, and we would rather be away from the body and at home with the Lord."

questions.question: So whether we are at home or away, we make it our aim to ____ him.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:9 (ESV): "So whether we are at home or away, we make it our aim to please him."

questions.question: For we must all appear before the ____ of Christ, so that each one may receive what is due for what he has done in the body, whether good or evil.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:10 (ESV): "For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each one may receive what is due for what he has done in the body, whether good or evil."

questions.question: Therefore, knowing the fear of the Lord, we ____ others.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:11 (ESV): "Therefore, knowing the fear of the Lord, we persuade others. But what we are is known to God, and I hope it is known also to your conscience."

questions.question: For the love of Christ ____ us, because we have concluded this: that one has died for all, therefore all have died;
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:14 (ESV): "For the love of Christ controls us, because we have concluded this: that one has died for all, therefore all have died;" (Note: "compels" is used in some translations, "controls" in ESV).

questions.question: and he died for all, that those who live might no longer live for themselves but for him who for their sake ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:15 (ESV): "and he died for all, that those who live might no longer live for themselves but for him who for their sake died and was raised."

questions.question: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a ____. The old has passed away; behold, the new has come.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:17 (ESV): "Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away; behold, the new has come."

questions.question: All this is from God, who through Christ reconciled us to himself and gave us the ministry of ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:18 (ESV): "All this is from God, who through Christ reconciled us to himself and gave us the ministry of reconciliation;"

questions.question: Therefore, we are ____ for Christ, God making his appeal through us.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:20 (ESV): "Therefore, we are ambassadors for Christ, God making his appeal through us. We implore you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God."

questions.question: For our sake he made him to be sin who knew no sin, so that in him we might become the ____ of God.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:21 (ESV): "For our sake he made him to be sin who knew no sin, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God."

key_verse_text: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away; behold, the new has come.
